title: gfilho.net — Monitoring
description: Availability, traffic, tunnel, services and host of gfilho.net

list.name: WSL starts
list.textFormat: The site was offline before this point

panels.title: Health
panels.description: Live state of the site. Site down but Origin up → Cloudflare or the tunnel; both down → nginx or WSL. With the PC or WSL off there is no data and nothing here can notify you: pair this with an external uptime monitor (README → Monitoring).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|[Pp]ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | path =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` [$__range]))

sum(sum_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|[Pp]ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Lifecycle
panels.description: TLS expires and sec.txt expires = time left until the TLS certificate and /.well-known/security.txt expire (renew security.txt before 30 days; Cloudflare renews the certificate). Offline = time WSL was not running (from the systemd journal): the site was down then.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Every check as one continuous status line. Green = OK, red = failing. Public pages every 60 s, origin and staging every 30 s, 301 redirects and DNS every 5 min. Blank = monitoring was not running.

panels.title: Firing now
panels.description: Native Grafana alert list of the Prometheus rules (monitoring/prometheus/rules.yml).

panels.title: Alert history
panels.description: When each alert was firing in the selected range (red bars).

panels.title: Response time by phase
panels.description: Where the time of a request to https://gfilho.net/ goes: DNS, connect, TLS, processing (edge → tunnel → nginx) and transfer.

panels.title: Public vs origin
panels.description: Total time from outside (Cloudflare + tunnel) next to nginx answered directly. The difference is the round trip over the internet.

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Visitor requests by HTTP status class (nginx access log). 4xx spikes are usually bots probing for files that do not exist.

targets.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|[Pp]ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: All requests handled by nginx (including staging and the monitoring probes) and those that came in through the tunnel.

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: The 10 most viewed pages (200 or 304), without CSS, JS, images and technical files.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (path) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|[Pp]ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | path !~ `^/(assets|cdn-cgi)/.*` | path !~ `.*\.(png|ico|svg|xml|txt|webmanifest|jpg|woff2|js|css|map)$` [$__range])))

panels.title: Top 404s
panels.description: Requested paths that do not exist. Mostly bots looking for WordPress, .env files and similar: harmless here, none of it exists.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (path) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|[Pp]ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status="404" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top referrers
panels.description: Where page views came from (links from the site itself are left out).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (referer) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|[Pp]ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | path =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` | referer != "-" | referer !~ `https?://(www\.)?gfilho\.net.*` [$__range])))

panels.title: Humans vs bots
panels.description: Page views by client type, from the User-Agent.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|[Pp]ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | path =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` | agent !~ `(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|facebookexternalhit|preview|feed|monitor|scan|python|go-http|wget).*` [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|[Pp]ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | path =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` | agent =~ `(?i).*(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|facebookexternalhit|preview|feed|monitor|scan|python|go-http|wget).*` [$__range]))

panels.title: Bytes served
panels.description: Bytes sent to visitors per interval (same filters as Page views).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|[Pp]ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Tunnel traffic & errors
panels.description: HTTP status codes returned by the origin through the tunnel (areas), and requests or streams cloudflared could not deliver (red lines, should stay at 0).

panels.title: Edge link
panels.description: Active tunnel connections (normal 4, dashed line) and new registrations on the left axis; smoothed QUIC round-trip time of each connection on the right axis.

panels.title: nginx connections
panels.description: Open connections in nginx (stub_status).

panels.title: Tunnel → Cloudflare data centres
panels.description: cloudflared keeps 4 connections open to the Cloudflare network for redundancy. Each chip shows the Cloudflare data centre one connection is attached to (named after the nearest airport: LIS = Lisbon, AMS = Amsterdam). Visitors reach the site through any of them; if one drops, the others keep it online.

panels.title: Services
panels.description: systemd state of the hosting services as a status grid (green = running, red = stopped), one cell per interval.

panels.title: Automatic restarts
panels.description: Times systemd restarted the service (Restart=on-failure) since WSL started, and units in a failed state.

panels.title: CPU & disk
panels.description: CPU use of the WSL VM (includes the Ascender lab that shares it) and used space on the virtual disk (/), computed like df. Dashed line: 90 %.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used and available memory in the WSL VM.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Traffic on the physical network interfaces (eth*); localhost, Docker and Kubernetes interfaces are left out.

panels.title: Publishing
panels.description: The production web root (/var/www/html) and the snapshots kept by deploy.sh and install-nginx.sh in /var/backups/gfilho.

panels.title: Installed versions
panels.description: Hosting components (refreshed every 2 minutes).

panels.title: nginx errors
panels.description: nginx error.log. "open() failed" means a request for a file that does not exist (a 404).

panels.title: Service warnings
panels.description: Warnings and errors from cloudflared, nginx, logrotate and the metrics timer (systemd journal).

panels.title: Recent requests
panels.description: Latest visitor requests to production, without monitoring probes and automated tools.
